title: The Olympic Games, Then and Now
subtitle: 考点：奥运历史 / Greek, ceremony, worldwide
passage: The first Olympic Games were held in ancient Greece more than two thousand years ago. At that time, only men took part, and the Games were in honour of the Greek gods. The athletes ran, jumped and threw things, and the winners received crowns made of olive leaves, not gold medals.

The modern Olympic Games began in 1896 in Athens, Greece. Today they are held every four years in different cities, and athletes from all over the world compete. There are opening and closing ceremonies, and the athletes march into the stadium with their national flags. Millions of people watch the Games on TV. The Olympic motto is 'Faster, Higher, Stronger', and it reminds everyone to try their best and respect other players.
